title: Extract packs_validate.go from packs.go
description:
## What
Create `core/controlplane/gateway/packs_validate.go` by moving validation, extraction, and JSON normalization utilities OUT of `packs.go`. This is a clean contiguous block (lines 1907-2537).

## Exact items to move

### Manifest Loading & Validation
- `loadPackBundleFromReader` (lines 1907-1922)
- `loadPackManifest` (lines 1924-1946)
- `validatePackManifest` (lines 1948-1988)
- `ensureProtocolCompatible` (lines 1990-1998)
- `ensureCoreVersionCompatible` (lines 2000-2018)

### Semver Parsing
- `parseSemver` (lines 2020-2047)
- `compareSemver` (lines 2049-2059)

### Patch Validation
- `validateConfigPatch` (lines 2077-2086)
- `validatePoolsPatch` (lines 2088-2123)
- `extractPools` (lines 2125-2140)
- `validateTimeoutsPatch` (lines 2142-2176)

### Resource File Loaders
- `loadSchemaFile` (lines 2178-2196)
- `loadWorkflowFile` (lines 2198-2220)
- `normalizeWorkflowMap` (lines 2222-2233)
- `hashWorkflow` (lines 2235-2237)
- `workflowToMap` (lines 2239-2252)
- `loadDataFile` (lines 2254-2268)
- `loadPatchFile` (lines 2270-2276)

### JSON Normalization & Patching
- `normalizeJSON` (lines 2278-2304)
- `deepCopy` (lines 2306-2319)
- `mergePatch` (lines 2321-2340)
- `buildDeletePatch` (lines 2342-2356)
- `hashValue` (lines 2358-2365)
- `canonicalJSON` (lines 2367-2373)
- `appendCanonical` (lines 2375-2392)
- `appendCanonicalMap` (lines 2394-2414)
- `appendCanonicalSlice` (lines 2416-2428)

### Archive & File System
- `isTarGz` (lines 2430-2433)
- `exists` (lines 2435-2438)
- `findPackRoot` (lines 2440-2459)
- `extractTarGzReader` (lines 2461-2518)
- `safeJoin` (lines 2520-2537)

### Also move extraction safety constants from lines 54-58
- `maxPackUploadBytes`, `maxPackFiles`, `maxPackFileBytes`, `maxPackUncompressedBytes`, `maxCatalogBytes`

### Also move from lines 2061-2075
- `shouldSkipConfigOverlay` (lines 2061-2066)
- `hasPoolOverlay` (lines 2068-2075)

## How
1. Create `packs_validate.go` with `package gateway`
2. Add imports: `archive/tar`, `compress/gzip`, `crypto/sha256`, `encoding/json`, `errors`, `fmt`, `io`, `io/fs`, `os`, `path/filepath`, `sort`, `strconv`, `strings`, plus project imports like `buildinfo`
3. Move all listed items
4. Remove from packs.go
5. Run `go build ./cmd/cordum-api-gateway`

## Notes
- Lines 1907-2537 is a nearly contiguous block — easy extraction
- The safety constants (maxPackUploadBytes etc.) at lines 54-58 should be in their own const block in the new file
- `shouldSkipConfigOverlay` and `hasPoolOverlay` at lines 2061-2075 are utility functions used by overlay management; move them too
definitionOfDone: packs_validate.go exists with package gateway header
All listed validation/extraction functions moved from packs.go
packs.go no longer contains any of the moved items

implementationPlan.description:
